verdict.rationale: The only policy-related evidence is a passing mention that the SOC 2 Launchpad guide helps you "action policies". Nothing in the pack documents a lawyer-grade template library, a policy editor, versioning, approval workflows, or per-employee acceptance tracking. The GDPR document pack in the compliance-skills repo covers a different capability, generating documents from a code scan, and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a founder, policies come from a lawyer-grade template library with an editor, versioning, approvals, and per-employee acceptance tracking
